findings.reason: the plan should extend the owner (give reckon/clones.py:changed_paths a fail-closed variant, or have recovery delegate to it) rather than add a parallel git reader; the only contract the new function adds is None-on-error vs []-on-error, which belongs on the owner.
findings.text: this plan's §5 landing (commit cc17465eff, "review-carries-forward") added _changed_paths_between, a `git diff --name-only OLDER..NEWER` reader, beside reckon/clones.py:674 changed_paths(tree, base_sha, tip) which already runs `git`, the same verb and the same --name-only and the same `[line for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]` post-processing — so the repository now has a second reader of the same fact and a fix to one (path quoting, rename detection, an error contract) will not reach the other

findings.reason: the plan already says the reflex must resolve the tier "through promotion's own resolver"; the honest change is to move the input-gathering into reckon/review_tiers.py (the owner of the tier decision) behind one public function that both promotion and recovery call, instead of a private cross-module helper wrapped by a second private helper.
findings.text: recovery._sweep_review_tier reaches across modules into promotion's private promotion._run_review_tier through a function-local import, and its body adds nothing over that call but an except returning review_tiers.FULL — so the tier resolver's input-gathering (record + manifest_commits to changed paths, changed lines, spec level, capability risk) now has two public entry points (promotion._run_review_tier and this wrapper) that must be kept in step by hand, and the reflex depends on a leading-underscore symbol

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — one module, reckon/review_tiers.py, hides the whole tier rule (SPA-aware runtime-source classification, spec-level and capability-risk precedence, fail-closed handling of an unmeasured diff) behind review_tier(...); its callers feed inputs rather than re-deriving the rule.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the §5 carry-forward's recovery._changed_paths_between re-implements the git changed-path reader that reckon/clones.py:changed_paths already owns.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §2's "What the code holds at 99455576" states the search (reuse map, reckon/path_classes.py, reckon/_plan_html.py:164, the _require_review_waiver seam), and the landed reckon/review_tiers.py imports reckon.path_classes.path_class rather than carrying a second classifier.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — recovery._sweep_review_tier (reckon/crew/recovery.py:3787) wraps promotion's private _run_review_tier with an except-and-default, giving the tier resolver two entry points.
